NOTE ON NAMING
  This file is MANIFEST_2026-09-13.txt, deliberately NOT "MANIFEST.txt".
  dist/MANIFEST.txt already exists and documents the 2026-09-12 tarball.
  Overwriting it would destroy the record of the earlier archive.
  Nothing in dist/ was deleted, renamed or overwritten by W15.

RECONCILIATION
  !! READ THIS BEFORE COMPARING WITH MANIFEST.txt (2026-09-12).
  The two manifests count DIFFERENT DENOMINATORS, and the difference is
  not a discrepancy:

    MANIFEST.txt (2026-09-12) reconciled against FILES ON DISK  : 24,975
    This manifest reconciles against the GIT-VISIBLE FILE SET   :      248

  W15's candidate set came from `git ls-files -co --exclude-standard`,
  which already honours .gitignore. node_modules/ and .next/ are therefore
  absent from the candidate list rather than "excluded" from it, and this
  manifest does NOT claim a whole-disk reconciliation it did not perform.
  The on-disk totals for node_modules/ and .next/ are NOT-MEASURED by W15.

  Candidates (git-visible, tracked + untracked, .gitignore honoured) : 248
  Excluded                                                          :  64
    _legacy/.next-stale-next14/   (stale Next 14 build cache)       :  48
    Claude outputs/               (agent session artefacts, mode 700):   9
    artifacts/                    (screenshots + e2e output)        :   5
    dist/                         (this directory; no self-nesting) :   2
  Included in archive                                               : 184

  Arithmetic: 184 + 64 = 248  (included + excluded = git-visible candidates)

EXCLUSION POLICY
  Matched to MANIFEST.txt (2026-09-12) rather than invented. That manifest
  excluded node_modules/, .next/, .git/, _legacy/.next-stale-next14/,
  artifacts/ and "Claude outputs/". W15 applied the same list.

  !! WHY THIS MATTERS: W15's FIRST attempt omitted the
  _legacy/.next-stale-next14/ exclusion and produced a 25,664,642-byte
  archive -- 5.9x larger -- because that directory holds ~20 MB of stale
  Next 14 build cache (single largest member: a 9,070,355-byte webpack
  pack.gz). It was caught by enumerating the archive's ten largest members
  instead of trusting the tar exit code. The oversized archive was
  overwritten by the correct one; nothing else was deleted.

DELTA vs THE 2026-09-12 ARCHIVE
  2026-09-12 : 140 files, 4,105,123 bytes
  2026-09-13 : 184 files, 4,365,269 bytes
  Difference : +44 files, +260,146 bytes

  The +44 is the second overnight run's additions -- the lead sink
  (lib/leads/**), the measurement layer (lib/analytics/**), content/,
  lib/seo/, the new sections (Speaker, PrivacyNotice, TrackedLink) with
  their tests, playwright.config.ts, and the e2e spec.
  !! W15 did NOT verify this figure file-by-file against the older archive.
  The +44 is arithmetic on two totals, not a diff. Treat it as such.

  _legacy/ holds 19 files in both archives -- 18 replaced source files plus
  WHY.md -- unchanged, byte-for-byte, across both runs.

WHAT IS *NOT* IN THIS ARCHIVE
  - node_modules/ and .next/  -- reproducible; `npm install` restores them.
  - .git/                     -- 314 files; history is NOT archived here.
  - artifacts/                -- the browser-pass screenshots and e2e output.
  - "Claude outputs/"         -- agent session artefacts; directory is mode
                                 700 and was left untouched.
  - Any environment variable VALUE. Only NAMES appear anywhere in the
    source, each declared once as a typed constant.

HONEST LIMIT OF THIS MANIFEST
  - The archive was ENUMERATED (tar -tzf) but not EXTRACTED and not test-
    restored. That it unpacks cleanly is NOT-MEASURED.
  - The SHA-256 above is of the file as written at 06:32 on 2026-09-13.
  - W15 deleted nothing, archived nothing else, and moved nothing. The
    2026-09-12 tarball and its MANIFEST.txt are untouched.
  - Every count in this file was measured by W15 at packaging time. None
    was copied from MANIFEST.txt except the two figures explicitly
    attributed to it in the DELTA section above.
